patterns.pattern: Applications denied as late (over 240 days after the first bill)
patterns.note: AB 2297: no application deadline from 2025-01-01, even while the old policy was in effect.

patterns.pattern: Applications denied for no pay stubs when other proof was on file

patterns.pattern: Payment plans: 12 equal monthly payments rounded up to the dollar, at least $25, no interest
patterns.note: Fewer months only when $25 a month pays it off sooner.

patterns.pattern: CalFresh enrollees handled inconsistently (some approved free without income documents, others left in needs info or closed)
